title: Google’s new Flash models target cheaper, more reliable AI agents
friendlyTitle: Google makes AI agents faster and cheaper
summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and the cyber-focused 3.5 Flash Cyber. The company says 3.6 Flash uses fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash, requires fewer reasoning steps and tool calls, and costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
friendlySummary: Google released three Gemini Flash models. They are designed to do multi-step work with less time, fewer tokens and lower cost.
whyItMatters: Agent economics depend on the cost of completing a task, not just the price of one prompt. Models that use fewer tokens and tool calls can make always-on assistants and high-volume business workflows more affordable.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make useful AI helpers cheaper for people and businesses to run every day.
